name: batchwise-pro
description: BatchWise Pro — run locally with on-disk JSON and PDF storage

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist --prefix desktop
scripts.dist:desktop:win: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist:win --prefix desktop
scripts.dist:desktop:mac: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist:mac --prefix desktop
scripts.dist:desktop:linux: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist:linux --prefix desktop
